decisions.reason: As a flagship biodynamic yogurt line closely tied to the firm's core organic dairy positioning and already retained in 2024, it is very likely to stay unless demand has fallen materially.

This mild sliced cheese is a close extension of the firm's established cheese business and was given its own product page in 2024, so it is more likely to be kept than withdrawn after only a short market test.

This sliced butter cheese fits the firm's traditional dairy capabilities and broad assortment, but as a newer 2024 launch without the strategic prominence of product A it faces a modestly higher withdrawal risk.
